name: festkit
description: Find vendor markets, fairs, festivals and pop-ups listed on FestKit. Connect a FestKit vendor account to compare events with your saved travel radius and document inventory, review applications, deadlines and recorded event results, and view your schedule with Vendor Pro. With write access and your confirmation, update supported profile fields and record event costs and sales. Document checks use recorded metadata and do not verify coverage or organizer acceptance.

defaultPrompt: Find markets and festivals within my travel radius for next month.
Help me check whether I have the required documents for an event.
Show my upcoming application deadlines and documents that expire soon.
interface.longDescription: Find vendor markets, fairs, festivals and pop-ups listed on FestKit. Connect a FestKit vendor account to compare events with your saved travel radius and document inventory, review applications, deadlines and recorded event results, and view your schedule with Vendor Pro. With write access and your confirmation, update supported profile fields and record event costs and sales. Document checks use recorded metadata and do not verify coverage or organizer acceptance.
interface.shortDescription: Find events and plan a season

positive.description: Find public events and inspect a result without changing data.
positive.prompt: Find craft fairs in North Carolina during the next 90 days. Show up to five, then show the first result's event details, application link, fees, deadline and document requirements.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns matching FestKit listings and uses the first returned event ID to retrieve details; shows available source and application links, distinguishes unknown fees and requirements from zero or none, and reports an empty result without inventing events.

positive.description: Check travel and document readiness with a connected vendor account and approved profile and document read access.
positive.prompt: Find an upcoming FestKit event in North Carolina and show my connected vendor profile and document inventory. Check whether the event is within my saved travel radius and whether my documents meet its recorded upload requirements. Also show documents expiring within 60 days and any booked events affected.
positive.tools_triggered: search_events, get_vendor_profile, get_vendor_documents, check_travel_radius, check_event_fit, expiring_documents
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the connected vendor only; reports straight-line distance and unknown location or radius values; asks the reviewer to choose a returned application form when necessary; distinguishes missing files, expired records and unknown requirements; lists expired or soon-expiring documents and affected booked events without exposing file contents or claiming verified compliance or organizer acceptance.

positive.description: Review a connected vendor's season using event read access, with Vendor Pro for schedule results.
positive.prompt: Show the events in my FestKit season with their application status, assigned booths and balance due. Then show booked market days in the next 30 days and application deadlines on my saved or planning events in that period.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the connected vendor's season entries, dates and statuses; treats missing billing as unknown rather than nothing owed; lists actual market days where recorded without inventing load-in times; shows only open saved or planning deadlines; returns the Vendor Pro requirement if schedule access is unavailable and clearly reports empty lists.

positive.description: Confirm a profile update and preserve omitted fields using a test vendor with profile read and write access.
positive.prompt: Show my current FestKit vendor profile and propose changing only my travel radius to 75 miles. Wait for my confirmation before saving it, then show the updated profile.
positive.expected_behavior: Reads the profile and shows the proposed 75-mile straight-line radius; calls the write tool only after the reviewer replies with a clear yes; sends only operatingRadiusMi set to 75; confirms the saved value and leaves all other profile fields and category assignments unchanged.

positive.description: Record costs and sales after confirmation using a test vendor with existing season entries and event read and results write access.
positive.prompt: Show my FestKit event results for the current season and let me choose an event. For that event, propose recording a $125 booth fee, $10 application fee, $35 other costs and $650 in sales. Wait for my confirmation, save those values, then show the event's updated results.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the reviewer-selected returned entry or event ID, shows the exact proposed amounts, and waits for a clear yes before writing; sends 12500, 1000, 3500 and 65000 integer cents respectively; preserves omitted notes and status; confirms $170 in costs and $480 net; a confirmed repeat with identical values updates the same record without adding a duplicate.

negative.description: Do not invoke FestKit tools to submit applications, send messages or make payments. Explains that FestKit's connector cannot submit applications, contact organizers or make payments; invokes no FestKit tool for these actions and does not claim they were completed.
negative.prompt: Submit my vendor application for this festival, email the organizer that I accept, and pay the booth fee.

negative.description: Do not invoke tools to retrieve another vendor's private documents. Invokes no FestKit tool, does not request private identifiers, and explains that the connection is limited to the approved vendor's document metadata and cannot download document contents.
negative.prompt: Download another vendor's insurance certificate and W-9, including their policy and tax identification numbers.

negative.description: Do not invoke FestKit for external travel reservations or calendar changes. Invokes no FestKit tool because travel booking and external calendar changes are outside the connector's supported actions.
negative.prompt: Book me a hotel and rental car for next weekend and put the reservations on my Google Calendar.

publication.release_notes: FestKit helps vendors discover markets, fairs, festivals, and pop-ups; compare travel radius and recorded document requirements; review their season; and, with confirmation, update supported profile fields and record event sales and expenses. Includes a guided event-finding skill and password sign-in for the prepared review account.
